_: Pre-registered work for tools/watch.py. A person writes these; the loop only runs them.
That split is the design, not a limitation: [T-065] found every narrowing in this
project came from choosing WHICH held-fixed dimension to vary, which is judgement.
An agent that picked its own next experiment would be guessing at the one step that
ticket  : the E- id, so the report can read the pre-stated outcomes back out
runner  : path relative to the repo root
model   : for the preflight smoke test
expect  : verdicts that are EXPECTED. Anything else stops the queue and escalates.

A job stays queued until a person removes it — the loop re-reads the file and will re-run anything still in it. [E-038] was removed 2026-10-15 after its result was read and recorded; leaving it in made the loop re-run a finished experiment and re-escalate its verdict every 15 minutes, which blocked [E-039] behind it.

jobs._why: The within-benchmark control [R-014] found. MQuAKE names the edited subject iff the edit is on hop 1, so hop-1 and hop-2 questions differ in that one property inside one dataset. NO ESCAPE is the outcome that costs us most — it would make [E-037]'s reading of Table 11 wrong and force a rewrite of §4.6 — and it is live, because [E-019] measured 0.95 for subject-LATE probes at this layer, so prefix-sharing is not the only route to a high coefficient. `expect` empty: first run, and every branch is worth waking for.
